description: Drafts a Teams product update announcing a shipped feature to the whole business, and gathers the before/after screenshots that go with it. Use when asked to write a product update, announce or write up a feature that has shipped or merged, tell the business about a release, or collect before/after media for one. Calls `write-in-my-voice` for the prose and `humanizer` to strip AI tells.
